assertion.rationale: F8: the deployer service principal holds Application.ReadWrite.All when apply-entra.ps1 only creates and updates three apps it owns, so the actual privilege needed is Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy — a strictly narrower grant. F13: privilege across the estate is inverted — Owner and ReadWrite.All exist where automation is fully automated, while seven documented least-privilege workload grants (data-api, mcp-tools, cost-ingest) exist nowhere in code. F7, this control's other contributor, is now CLOSED (Task 9): mls-verifier is federated to its own environment:verify subject distinct from the deployer's, so the verify-job escalation path F7 described no longer exists (see 3.1.6/3.1.7).

recommendation: Swap Application.ReadWrite.All for Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy on the deployer. Express the seven documented workload RBAC grants (data-api, mcp-tools, cost-ingest) in IaC. F7's remediation (the verify environment split) is DONE and needs no further action.
